The terms that govern bookings, events and use of our facility.

Welcome to the website of ELEVENO (“Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us”). By accessing or using our website, booking courts, making purchases, or participating in our services, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions (“Terms”).

1. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account, book a court, or make purchases online. Minors may use our facilities only under the supervision of a parent or legal guardian who agrees to these Terms on their behalf.

  • Court reservations must be made through our website or authorized platform.
  • Full payment may be required at the time of booking.
  • Reservations are confirmed only after payment is successfully processed.

2.2 Cancellations & Refunds

  • Cancellations made at least 24 hours prior to the reservation may qualify for a refund or credit.
  • Late cancellations or no-shows may result in forfeiture of fees.
  • The Company reserves the right to cancel or reschedule reservations due to maintenance, weather, private events, or unforeseen circumstances.

2.3 Code of Conduct

All guests must:

  • Follow posted rules and staff instructions.
  • Wear appropriate athletic attire and footwear.
  • Use equipment responsibly.
  • Refrain from disruptive, unsafe, or unlawful behavior.

We reserve the right to refuse service or remove any individual who violates these rules without refund.
